column3: does not run in SPITBOL: ERROR 121 -- len argument is negative or too large, 1brc.sno(56), a graceful fatal report at rc=0; source checked 2026-09-08 (coo): stmt 56 `fmt LEN(SIZE(v) - 1) . x REM . d = x '.' d          :(RETURN)` -- LEN is handed SIZE(v)-1, which is -1 when v is the empty string, and SPITBOL treats a negative LEN as fatal rather than as a pattern that simply fails.

does not run in SPITBOL: ERROR 038 -- goto undefined label, asgn1.sno(5), a graceful fatal report at rc=0; source checked 2026-09-08 (coo): stmt 5 `INPUT(.words, 3, "words.txt")                         :F(error)` -- the failure goto names label `error`, which the program never defines, so SPITBOL stops at the goto rather than at the INPUT.

does not run in SPITBOL: ERROR 248 -- attempted redefinition of system function, expr_parser_stub.sno(20), a graceful fatal report at rc=0; source checked 2026-09-08 (coo): stmt 20 `DEFINE('ITEM()')` -- the program defines a function named ITEM, which collides with a name SPITBOL already carries; the same collision class as the DATA-prototype accessors in spitbol_testpgms test6 and test7.
